questions.prompt: What do you usually do when you stop sleeping in the morning?
Which word means traveling regularly between home and work?
questions.explanation: A commute is the regular trip between home and work.

questions.prompt: What phrase means going out to complete small tasks like grocery shopping or picking up a prescription?
questions.explanation: "Run errands" means to complete small necessary tasks outside the home.

questions.prompt: Which word can correct or clarify something that was just said?
questions.explanation: "Actually" is often used to correct or clarify information.

questions.prompt: I usually _____ as soon as I hear my alarm.
questions.explanation: "Get up" means to leave your bed after waking.

questions.prompt: She tries to _____ at the gym three times a week.
Even on busy days, I try to _____ a quick lunch with a friend.
questions.explanation: "Squeeze in" means to find time for something in a busy schedule.

questions.prompt: Eu geralmente vou para a cama às onze.
questions.answer: I usually go to bed at eleven.|I generally go to bed at eleven.
questions.explanation: "Go to bed" means to lie down to sleep.

questions.prompt: Meu despertador toca às seis todas as manhãs.
questions.answer: My alarm goes off at six every morning.|Every morning, my alarm goes off at six.
questions.explanation: "My alarm goes off" means that the alarm starts ringing.

questions.prompt: Depois de várias tentativas, ela finalmente conseguiu o emprego.
questions.answer: After several attempts, she eventually got the job.|She eventually got the job after several attempts.
questions.explanation: "Eventually" means in the end, after some time or effort.
